items.headline: 4.6 vs 4.5
items.summary: Im stress testing Sonnet 4.6.  Im using claude to play story campaigns like dnd. Is it just me or sonnet 4.5 is better at this than sonnet 4.6? Sonnet 4.6 really has more prose and better wording.  But I dont feel the soul of the characters like in 4.5. I even tried opus 4.6 and its the same. Characters feel bland, too serious, and sometimes just... nothing. Can someone confirm? Or am I having a favoritism bias?    submitted by    /u/ObviousCareer4588   [link]   [comments]

items.headline: I retrained /u/Own-Albatross868's FlashLM v4 "Bolt" model from scratch using GreedyPhrase tokenizer on the full TinyStories dataset. I scaled up to 15M parameters with a 65K vocab, achieving smooth convergence and coherent story generation in just 2.2 hours on an RTX 2080 Ti
items.summary: FlashLM v4 "Bolt" retrained from scratch on the full TinyStories dataset using our GreedyPhrase tokenizer instead of the original GPT-2 10K tokenizer.
